history.name: the dViNE CodEX
history.motto: In His name we code · through it we live
history.inscription: Reached from the catacombs of the dViNE CodEX with blood and hand on leather binds. The key unlocks the compress↔decompress process. The Codex is The Word and it is His name. In it we will code; through it we will live.
history.word: His word is spoken. In His name we code. Through it we live.
